description: This PHP source file defines the OrderStatus class within the Opencart admin model for localisation, providing methods to manage order status records in the database including create, read, update, delete, and related description management.

classes.name: OrderStatus
classes.description: A model class responsible for managing order status entries in the database, including CRUD operations and description handling within the OpenCart admin localisation module.

methods.name: addOrderStatus
methods.description: Creates a new order status record with data provided for different languages, inserting into the database and updating caches.

methods.name: editOrderStatus
methods.description: Edits an existing order status record by deleting it and re-adding its descriptions.

methods.name: deleteOrderStatus
methods.description: Deletes an order status record based on its primary key.

methods.name: deleteOrderStatusesByLanguageId
methods.description: Deletes all order status records associated with a specific language ID.

methods.name: getOrderStatus
methods.description: Retrieves a specific order status record by ID for the current language.

methods.name: getOrderStatuses
methods.description: Retrieves a list of order statuses, optionally filtered, sorted, and paginated, with caching.

methods.name: getTotalOrderStatuses
methods.description: Returns the total count of order status records, optionally filtered by language.

methods.name: addDescription
methods.description: Inserts a description for an order status in a specific language.

methods.name: deleteDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Deletes all descriptions for a specific language ID.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Fetches a specific order status description by order status ID and language ID.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Fetches all descriptions for a given order status ID across multiple languages.

methods.name: getDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Retrieves all order status descriptions for a given language ID.
